rater_1_rationale: Flags NetworkPolicies whose podSelector matches no deployment, a broken cross-object reference, so hygiene (kube-linter docs).
rater_2_rationale: Flags NetworkPolicies that do not select any pods, an unused resource rather than a security or availability issue (kube-linter v0.8.3).

rater_1_rationale: Flags NetworkPolicy ingress/egress peers whose podSelector matches no deployment, a dangling reference, so hygiene (kube-linter docs).
rater_2_rationale: Flags NetworkPolicy peer selectors that match no pods, flagging unused ingress/egress rules (kube-linter v0.8.3).

rater_1_rationale: Flags Services whose selector matches no deployment, a dangling reference, so hygiene (kube-linter docs).
rater_2_rationale: Flags Services that do not match any pods, indicating an unused or misconfigured service (kube-linter v0.8.3).

rater_1_rationale: Flags Prometheus ServiceMonitors whose selectors match no Service, a dangling reference, so hygiene (kube-linter docs).
rater_2_rationale: Flag ServiceMonitors that do not match any services, an unused monitoring configuration (kube-linter v0.8.3).

rater_1_rationale: Flags Services of forbidden types such as NodePort or LoadBalancer that expose workloads, a network-exposure issue, so security (kube-linter docs).
rater_2_rationale: Flags NodePort and LoadBalancer services, which expose pods on external interfaces (kube-linter v0.8.3).

rater_1_rationale: Flags liveness probes pointing at a port the container does not expose, a probe misconfiguration that breaks runtime health checking, so resource (kube-linter docs).
rater_2_rationale: Flags liveness probes to unexposed ports, a configuration inconsistency (kube-linter v0.8.3).
